title: How compartments talk: Compartment coupling guides cochlear development
content:
by Ippei Kishimoto, Alan G. Cheng

Morphogens cooperate to guide development of the inner ear cochlea, but how do compartments communicate? A recent study in PLOS Biology reveals how planar cell polarity of individual cells is integrated across distinct regional compartments to ensure proper organ morphogenesis.
